description: This PHP source file defines the Tasks class for handling SQLite database installation tasks within Drupal, including version requirements, form options, and connection management.

classes.name: Tasks
classes.description: Handles installation tasks specific to SQLite databases in Drupal, including version checks, form configuration, and connection handling.

methods.name: name
methods.description: Returns the name of the database type, 'SQLite'.

methods.name: minimumVersion
methods.description: Returns the minimum required SQLite version, '3.45'.

methods.name: getFormOptions
methods.description: Provides form options for database configuration, customizing the form for SQLite specifics.

methods.name: connect
methods.description: Attempts to connect to the SQLite database, creating it if it does not exist, and handles connection errors.
